settings.heading: Benefits of Plant-Based Pea Protein & Organic Brown Rice Protein
settings.row_content: Say hello to the power-packed protein blend at the heart of our Orenda Shape®: Pea Protein and Organic Brown Rice Protein (15g). This isn't just any ordinary protein duo; it's a vibrant synergy that offers a full array of amino acids, inclusive of BCAAs and all the nine essentials your body craves but can't whip up independently. Our stellar team of proteins not only enhances your general well-being, but also champions your fitness aspirations and nutritional necessities, and kindles your metabolism like a well-tended fire.*

settings.heading: Benefits of Including 12 Types of Greens
settings.row_content:
Introducing the green powerhouses of our Orenda Shape formula - Spirulina, Organic Kamut Grass, Barley Grass, Wheat Grass, and Spinach. These nutritional heroes aren't just for digestion; they're committed to supporting your overall well-being.*

Spirulina, a blue-green algae, is a complete protein, offering all essential amino acids, and is packed with antioxidants, aiding in cellular health and vitality. Organic Kamut Grass is a nutrient-dense grain that supports heart health and aids in supporting blood sugar levels.* Barley Grass, high in fiber and packed with vitamins, is your body's partner in detoxification, while Wheat Grass, rich in chlorophyll and various minerals, contributes to supporting energy levels and your immune system.*

Completing this remarkable lineup are Organic Oat Grass, Organic Flax, Chia Seed, Apple Fiber, Chlorella Powder, Pea Fiber, and Quinoa Sprout Powder. Each brings unique nutritional benefits, creating a blend that's as health-supporting as it is harmonious.

Organic Oat Grass offers a good dose of vitamins and minerals and supports a healthy inflammatory response, while Organic Flax and Chia Seed are both rich in omega-3 fatty acids, and offer digestive support. Apple Fiber aids in maintaining a healthy gut environment, while Chlorella Powder supports detoxification. Pea Fiber provides a feeling of fullness, aiding in support of weight management, and Quinoa Sprout Powder is a plant-based protein powerhouse.

Together, they form a nutritional ensemble, working in concert to enhance your health and vitality. With this blend of ingredients, you're not just fueling your body - you're investing in your wellness journey.

settings.heading: Learn more about Shape's Amino Acid profile
settings.row_content:
Our Orenda Shape® formulation boasts a carefully crafted blend of Pea and Organic Brown Rice proteins, providing a holistic approach to your protein intake. The magic lies in the harmony of these proteins, Pea and Organic Brown Rice proteins, each a complete source of all 9 essential amino acids, yet they shine in different areas. For instance, Pea protein? It's rich in lysine, an essential amino acid vital for protein synthesis and muscle recovery. But it's a tad low in cysteine and methionine.

And that's where Organic Brown Rice protein steps in! It's packed with cysteine and methionine, which support healthy skin, hair, nails, and metabolic processes.* However, it's a bit light on lysine. The solution? Combine them! Together, they create a superior amino acid profile that outclasses any single plant protein source, offering you all essential amino acids, including those all-important BCAAs (Branched Chain Amino Acids), for supporting muscle development and recovery.*

Orenda Shape® was designed to support your body in maintaining an active, balanced lifestyle. So whether you're vegan, vegetarian, or simply looking for a healthier protein alternative, Orenda Shape is here to support you in maintaining a balanced, nutritious lifestyle.

The nine essential amino acids are:

  • Histidine,
  • Isoleucine
  • Leucine
  • Lysine
  • Methionine
  • Phenylalanine
  • Threonine
  • Tryptophan
  • Valine

Of these three are BCAAs (Branched Chain Amino Acids):

  • Leucine
  • Isoleucine
  • Valine

The other amino acids in our protein blend are:

  • Alanine
  • Arginine
  • Aspartic
  • Cystine
  • Glutamic Acid
  • Glycine
  • Proline
  • Serine
  • Tyrosine

settings.heading: Benefits of Aronia Berry in Orenda Clean®
settings.row_content:
Picture this - a bright and powerful berry loaded with all the good stuff that's here to make your detox experience simply wonderful. That's our Aronia Fruit Powder, a superstar in our Orenda Clean® drink.

What's so special about it, you ask? Well, it's like a triple threat in the world of wellness. Packed with antioxidants, it’s as if it has a built-in shield that protects your body from those troublemaker free radicals. These antioxidants are like the bodyguards of your cells, always keeping an eye out for potential damage.

It doesn’t stop there, this berry is also a talented inflammation soother. With its anti-inflammatory properties, Aronia berries help support the reduction of inflammation, which can help to improve overall health.

The cherry on top? These berries work wonders supporting your body's natural detox processes. In our world that can sometimes be chock-full of toxins, Aronia berries are like that dependable friend who's always there to help you declutter, allowing your body to feel its absolute best.

So when you're sipping on your Orenda Clean®, think about the Aronia Berry Fruit Powder. It's there, making every sip count, helping you towards feeling your most vibrant, most healthy self. Cheers to that!

settings.heading: Benefits of Potassium Hydrogen-Glucarate (PHG), a water-soluble version of calcium d-glucarate, within our Orenda Clean®
settings.row_content:
Say hello to Potassium Hydrogen-Glucarate (PHG), a water-soluble version of calcium d-glucarate, nestled within our Orenda Clean® blend. It's like your personal detox assistant, working behind the scenes to help your body feel it's very best.

Here's where the magic happens: Your body has a natural process called glucuronidation. Think of it as your liver's private cleaning service, focused on detoxification at the cellular level. PHG takes the conductor's baton in this physiological orchestra, binding to toxins and turning them water soluble for easy elimination. Plus, it's a bit of a gatekeeper, keeping an eye out for any toxins that might try to sneak back into your system.

PHG is also a wellness multitasker. It's not just about detoxification. It also lends a helping hand to your liver, prostate, and breasts.* Picture it as a personal trainer for your organs, helping them stay fit and healthy.

Cholesterol on your mind? PHG's got that covered, too. It aids in supporting the maintenance of healthy cholesterol levels by supercharging the production of useful bile acids.* Think of it as an adept engineer, ensuring your body operates like a well-oiled machine.

And that's not all. PHG also plays a part in supporting the balancing act of inflammation, toning down those pro-inflammatory cytokines while amping up the friendly, anti-inflammatory ones.* Imagine it as a peacekeeper, maintaining harmony and balance within your body.

So, all things considered, PHG is another secret weapon in your wellness toolkit, tirelessly promoting health and vitality from within your Orenda Clean® drink. Here's to PHG, your steadfast ally on this journey to feeling absolutely fabulous!

settings.heading: What is the best dose of Berberine?
settings.row_content: For best results, take six capsules daily. The standard and most widely researched dose for Berberine is 1,000 mg daily of Berberine HCl, the specific type of Berberine contained in Orenda Burn®. Our 180ct bottle is perfect for this.

settings.heading: Should I try the Orenda 10-Day Detox Cleanse Bundle if I am on medication?
settings.row_content:
The Orenda 10-day Detox Cleanse Bundle was formulated with careful attention to safety. That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.

*The Orenda cleanse programs are intended as complete detoxification and weight loss programs for adults over 18 years old who are not pregnant or nursing. Results may vary. Exercise and proper diet are necessary to achieve and maintain weight loss. The Orenda 10-Day Cleanse bundle is intended as a complete detoxification and weight-loss program for adults aged 18 who are not pregnant or nursing. Combine the program with diet and exercise to maximize and maintain results. Consult your physician and follow all safety instructions before beginning any exercise program or using any supplement or meal replacement product. Weight loss should not be considered typical. Individual results will vary. Clients on the program can expect to lose 2.5-5.4 lbs. during the first 10 days and 1.3-3.3 lbs. per week for the remaining 90 days of the program. If you experience any pain or difficulty with exercises or diet, stop and consult your healthcare provider.
